about: The titles people earn (docs/design/skills-v2.md §11.8, D-183): very hard to get, their requirements hidden from the player (requires and watch are read only by src/people/9999976-titles and tools/lint-titles.mjs). effects use the skills' vocabulary and join their pool under the same caps; a title spends at most its weight's budget (vocab.json). honour and renown are paid once, on earning. earned is the world's sentence why, never the rule; No title is hinted at anywhere (order 92): no rumour, no card, no line in Records tells of a title before it is earned. Requirements are written cheapest first: they are read in order and stop at the first that fails.

titles.name: Blooded
titles.earned: You came out of your first battle cut and still standing. The old soldiers call you Blooded now, and pour you a cup from their own jug.
titles.text: Your first battle, and you bled in it, and lived. The old soldiers count you one of theirs.

titles.name: the Unbought
titles.earned: Purse after purse has gone back across the table untouched. People have begun to call you the Unbought, and to believe what you say.
titles.lost: You took the purse. By the next market day nobody calls you the Unbought, and nobody quite believes you either.
titles.text: Offered gold to bend, again and again, and never once bent. People believe your word for it.

appoint.label: a man no purse can move

titles.name: Ironhide
titles.earned: Ten times the surgeons have sewn you shut, and you have outlived most of them. They call you Ironhide in the camps, and mean it kindly.
titles.text: Cut, broken and sewn shut more times than most men are wounded once, and still here at forty.

titles.name: the Undefeated
titles.earned: After the twentieth fight in a row that ended with you standing, the soldiers began to say a word before your name: the Undefeated.
titles.lost: You are put down at last. Nobody says the Undefeated any more; some say it was never true.
titles.text: Twenty fights and never put down. Soldiers say it before they say your name.

appoint.label: the soldiers follow a captain called {title}

titles.name: Breaker of Champions
titles.earned: The best of three realms have gone down in front of you. Heralds have started calling you the Breaker of Champions, and the next champion is already nervous.
titles.text: The champions of three realms beaten in single combat.

titles.name: the Hundred-Day Wall
titles.earned: {place} stood more than a hundred days and did not fall. In the taverns they call you the Hundred-Day Wall.
titles.text: A walled place held against a siege of more than a hundred days, and never given up.

titles.name: the Peacemaker
titles.earned: Three wars ended with your seal on the terms. The envoys call you the Peacemaker, some of them sourly.
titles.text: Three wars ended by terms you made.

titles.name: the Silver Sage
titles.earned: Five of your pupils stand among the learned now, and your hair is white. The schools call you the Silver Sage.
titles.text: Old, learned, and the teacher of five who became learned in their turn.

titles.name: Faithful Unto Death
titles.earned: They offered you the door for one word against your faith, and you would not say it. The faithful have a name for you now: Faithful Unto Death.
titles.lost: You said the word. The faithful do not say your name the way they did.
titles.text: Kept your faith in a cell, with the door held open for one word against it.

appoint.label: a man who keeps faith under threat

titles.name: Butcher of {place}
titles.earned: Nobody in {place} will say your name. Everyone else says another one: the Butcher of {place}.
titles.text: A place put to the sword, its people with it, on your order or by your hand. Men fear the name, and are right to.

titles.name: Beast-Bane
titles.earned: Ten beasts stronger than you have died at your hand. Hunters and herdsmen call you Beast-Bane, and send for you first.
titles.text: Ten beasts slain, each one stronger than you were when you met it.

titles.name: Kingmaker
titles.earned: The one you put on the throne has sat on it a year, and the whole court knows whose arm put him there. They call you the Kingmaker, and not always in your hearing.
titles.text: A crown set on another's head by your plot or your arms, and still there a year later. One of a kind: one living holder.

titles.name: Sword of {realm}
titles.earned: No sword in {realm} is better than yours, and the crown has said so before the whole court: you are the Sword of {realm}.
titles.text: The best sword in the realm, a tourney won, and the crown's own word for it. One holder in each realm while he lives.

titles.name: Dragon Slayer
titles.earned: A dragon is dead, and you killed it. They are already singing it, and in every song you are the Dragon Slayer.
titles.text: A true dragon slain. One of a kind: one living holder; the next must wait for your grave.

appoint.label: who would not follow one who killed a dragon

titles.name: First of the Age
titles.earned: No one living has gone so far in an art as you have now, and no one in this age went there before you. The chroniclers write you down as the First of the Age.
titles.text: The first in this age to stand at the summit of an art. Given once an age, and never again in it.
